hf.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
hf.abstract: Successful tool-use trajectories are not necessarily useful supervision. Even successful interactions may underrepresent multi-step dependencies or contain actions that are unjustified by the information visible to the agent at decision time. We identify two coupled requirements for effective trajectory supervision: compositional coverage, so that important observation-action dependencies are represented, and decision grounding, so that each supervised action is supported by the learner-visible interaction history. We introduce Trajectory2Gym, which constructs executable interactions around under-supported compositional structures and derives supervision only from grounded decisions in their realized executions. Structural-support selection allocates the resulting experience, while parent-normalized supervised fine-tuning preserves the semantic interaction as the unit of training weight. This reframes trajectory generation as the deliberate construction of learnable interaction experience, rather than the collection of successful trajectories. Across five Qwen3 scales, Trajectory2Gym improves Tau1, Tau2, and BFCL at every tested scale, increasing the equal-weight three-benchmark mean by 16.9-29.8 percentage points. The gains are strongest in stateful and multi-turn interaction, where later decisions depend on earlier observations and feedback. Our results suggest that scaling tool-use agents depends not only on collecting more successful trajectories, but on constructing interactions whose dependencies are represented and whose decisions are learnable from the agent's visible history.
hf.titleZh: Trajectory2Gym：面向工具使用智能体的决策锚定组合式交互合成
hf.summaryZh: 成功的工具调用轨迹未必构成有效监督：这类交互常掩盖多步依赖，或包含在决策时刻可见信息不足以支撑的动作。Trajectory2Gym 针对支撑不足的组合结构主动构建可执行交互，并且只从真实执行中有据可依的决策上提取监督：结构支撑度选择负责分配经验，父样本归一化的监督微调则保证以完整语义交互作为训练权重单位。在五个 Qwen3 规模上，该方法在 Tau1、Tau2 与 BFCL 上均取得提升，三基准等权平均提高 16.9–29.8 个百分点，多轮有状态交互中收益最大。这表明扩展工具使用智能体不仅依赖收集更多成功轨迹，更依赖构造依赖被覆盖、决策可学的交互经验。
hf.reason: 工具使用 Agent 的轨迹合成与监督方法，直接命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
hf.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness. We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability. In addition, we design a Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module to provide evidence from the agent context, harness, and execution environment for LLM-based evaluation, and develop a Failure Attribution (FA) module that uses explicit mechanism chains to support attribution at the run level. Across 4 harnesses, 9 models, and 95 tasks, our evaluation of 3,420 runs yields macro-averaged harness scores ranging from 59.8% to 72.0%, while 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion. TraceTrial-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible foundation for comparing agent harnesses, diagnosing their failures, and studying how harness design interacts with model behavior.
hf.titleZh: TraceTrial:面向 AI Agent Harness 的可靠性与失败归因基准评测
hf.summaryZh: 现有 Agent 评测多聚焦模型能力与端到端表现，对承载执行的 harness 本身缺乏系统评估。TraceTrial-Bench 将 harness 可靠性拆成上下文、执行、治理、生命周期、可观测性、工具与验证七个组件，构建 95 个专家级、机制导向且带可执行或状态型真值的任务，并用 Trajectory Tracing 模块记录执行轨迹，以两层框架分别评 Agent 表现与 harness 可靠性；Multi-source Evidence Acquisition 汇集上下文、harness 与环境证据供 LLM 评判，Failure Attribution 模块以显式机制链支持 run 级归因。在 4 个 harness、9 个模型、95 个任务共 3420 次运行上，harness 宏平均得分 59.8%–72.0%，且 31.1% 的运行在至少违反一项 harness 判据的情况下仍完成任务。该基准为比较 harness、诊断失败及研究 harness 设计与模型行为的交互提供了可审计、可复现的基础。
hf.reason: Agent harness 评测基准，命中 Agent 与评测方法学方向

hf.title: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
hf.abstract: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce StreamVibe-Bench, a new benchmark serving as testbed for user intent interaction, with 4.1K evaluation samples and 85K training samples spanning explicit, implicit, and dynamic intents. Building on this benchmark, we develop StreamVibe-VL, a streaming proactive model that infers implicit user intents from continuous observations and dynamically tailors its interactions as these intents evolve. We further introduce StreamVibe-Harness, which maintains user intents as persistent states with a fleixble lifecycles via a hierarchical memory to track the latest user intent and environmental state. Our experiments reveal three key findings: (i) StreamVibe-VL preserves strong general video understanding while improving response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over other baselines; (ii) existing proactive models remain limited in understanding user intent and deciding when to respond, especially under implicit and dynamic intents; and (iii) StreamVibe-Harness further improves response consistency and adaptation over sustained interaction, resulting in a 12.3% gain in proactive interaction.
hf.titleZh: StreamVibe：面向不断演化用户意图的主动式视频智能体
hf.summaryZh: 现有视觉语言模型只能被动响应显式指令，难以从连续观察中推断隐式用户意图，也无法在意图持续变化时同步更新状态。为此，作者构建 StreamVibe-Bench（4.1K 评测样本、85K 训练样本，覆盖显式、隐式与动态意图），并提出流式主动模型 StreamVibe-VL 与 StreamVibe-Harness：后者用分层记忆把用户意图维护成带生命周期的持久状态，持续跟踪最新意图与环境状态。实验显示，StreamVibe-VL 在保持通用视频理解的同时，将响应时机与答案质量提升 10.7%；Harness 在长程交互中再带来 12.3% 的主动交互增益，并暴露出既有主动模型在隐式与动态意图下的明显不足。
hf.reason: 主动式 Agent 的 harness 与分层记忆，兼具基准与系统

hf.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
hf.abstract: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. We introduce DynaFlow, a framework that integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the action space of the main agent. The agent decides when collaboration is needed and generates task-specific programs that coordinate sub-agents through sequential or parallel execution, structured information exchange, and verification. Execution results and traces inform subsequent actions, enabling the agent to adapt collaboration as reasoning progresses. We train only the main agent through supervised fine-tuning on distilled trajectories, followed by refinement on examples filtered for unsupported premises, biased verification, and information-flow defects. All sub-agents remain fixed, separating orchestration learning from executor capability improvement. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, scientific question answering, and multi-hop retrieval, DynaFlow achieves 88.08% overall accuracy in Forced mode, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 10.90 percentage points with the same Qwen3.5-27B backbone. Workflow analysis finds more explicit use, verification, and refinement of upstream outputs after training, highlighting cross-stage information flow as a key dimension of multi-agent orchestration.
hf.titleZh: DynaFlow：学习自由形式的多智能体编排
hf.summaryZh: 针对多智能体系统依赖预定义协作结构、难以适配多样任务的问题，DynaFlow把自由形式的可执行工作流合成纳入主智能体的动作空间：主智能体自行判断何时需要协作，并生成任务专属程序，通过串行或并行执行、结构化信息交换与验证来协调固定的子智能体，执行结果与轨迹再反馈给后续决策。训练只针对主智能体，先对蒸馏轨迹做监督微调，再用按不支持前提、有偏验证与信息流缺陷筛出的样例做精修，从而把编排学习与执行器能力提升解耦。在数学推理、科学问答与多跳检索六个基准上，Forced模式下总体准确率达88.08%，同等Qwen3.5-27B骨干下超过最强基线10.90个百分点。工作流分析显示训练后主智能体更明确地使用、验证与精修上游输出，说明跨阶段信息流是多智能体编排的关键维度。
hf.reason: 多智能体编排学习，Agent方向核心且有系统实验

hf.title: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
hf.abstract: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today's MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.
hf.titleZh: InteractiveWorld:一个可验证的以人为中心的交互环境，用于构建更好的交互式 MLLM 助手
hf.summaryZh: 针对穿戴式自我中心 AI 助手缺少可验证测试环境、真实人机交互数据昂贵稀缺的问题，构建 InteractiveWorld 闭环仿真环境:助手给出指令，人类智能体自行观察场景、理解指令并独立行动，环境执行动作并更新下一帧观测。基于该环境发布 InteractiveBench，覆盖六类共 120 个多轮任务，每条指令都会影响最终结果，并由基于状态的可验证奖励打分。对 12 个前沿 MLLM 的测试显示其仍远非可靠助手，最强模型 Claude Fable 5.1 在长程 Guidance 与 Planning 任务上分别仅约 20% 与 25%。该平台为物理世界中的交互式 MLLM 助手研究提供了可验证的评测基础。
hf.reason: MLLM 交互式助手环境与可验证多轮评测，贴近 Agent 与评测方向

hf.title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
hf.abstract: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes. We introduce two complementary dimensions, work persistence and work openness, to characterize working conditions, and classify digital work into five forms according to task scope and organization. Building on this framework, we identify five core capability families required for reliable work execution and examine approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization. We further analyze existing evaluation methods and metrics from the perspective of work outcomes. Finally, we discuss future research directions, including sustained work delegation, adaptation to open environments, and the interaction between work execution and capability improvement. This paper provides a unified framework for understanding, optimizing, and evaluating work agents, supporting the development of systems capable of delivering reliable, verifiable, and practically valuable work outcomes.
hf.titleZh: 工作型 Agent：系统、能力与优化
hf.summaryZh: 针对 Agent 如何可靠完成被委派的工作缺乏统一视角这一问题，提出以工作为中心的系统级框架，把 work agent 视为基础模型与运行时 harness 的结合体，在有状态工作空间中执行任务并交付可验证结果。引入工作持久性与工作开放性两个维度刻画工作条件，并按任务范围与组织方式将数字工作分为五种形态。在此基础上归纳可靠执行所需的五类核心能力，梳理模型优化、harness 优化及二者联合优化的路径，并从工作产出角度分析现有评测方法与指标。适用于 Agent 系统设计、harness 工程与 Agentic RL 的方向定位与选型参考。
hf.reason: Agent 系统级综述，框架清晰，贴合 Agent 与 harness 方向

hf.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
hf.abstract: Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs. As such, the dataset can also be used to post-train LLMs to strengthen their continual learning capabilities.
hf.titleZh: 持续学习考试：面向 LLM Agent 长程 RSI 与经验学习的基准测试
hf.summaryZh: 现有评测多衡量单任务表现，难以反映 Agent 在长程工作中积累经验并持续改进的能力。CLE 由 50 余位领域专家构建，含 120 个真实职业任务，每任务为五级阶梯、共 600 关，覆盖 12 个职业领域、89 个岗位；须逐级通过，后级依赖前面积累的经验，由评估 Agent 按人工撰写的 rubric 打分。对比单次提交与「失败后给诊断反馈并允许一次修改」两种设置，17 组 harness-模型配置的完成率中位提升 5.3 个百分点，但最佳系统仅通过 47.7% 的关卡、仅在 23.3% 的任务上打通五级。该基准亦可作为后训练数据来源，用于强化模型的持续学习能力。
hf.reason: 大规模专家构建的 Agent 长程经验学习基准，直击评测与 Agent 方向

hf.title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
hf.abstract: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT, a large-scale Character-centric dataset and benchmark covering diverse Large-Angle Camera Trajectories, with accurate camera geometry and multi-view character observations for training and evaluation. We further propose WorldCast, a framework for world-consistent character video generation under diverse large-angle camera motions. Specifically, we back-project the initial frame into a 3D point cloud using estimated depth, align the point-cloud scale with the target camera trajectory, and render it along the trajectory to obtain explicit geometric guidance and coverage masks. To complement the incomplete character information, we introduce Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA). Using relative camera poses estimated jointly from the initial frame and multi-view character anchors, we express anchor and target-view geometry in a common coordinate frame. GAMA uses this geometric alignment to guide the retrieval and injection of view-relevant character features during generation. Evaluations across diverse large-angle camera trajectories demonstrate accurate trajectory following while preserving character geometry, appearance, and identity.
hf.titleZh: WorldCast：基于大角度相机控制的世界一致角色视频生成
hf.summaryZh: 大角度相机运动（旋转、平移与半径变化组合、任意初始方位角）下的角色视频生成，现有方法难以跟随轨迹，初始帧未见的角色区域还会出现几何畸变、外观退化与身份漂移。为此构建 CLACT 大规模角色中心数据集与 benchmark，提供精确相机几何与多视角角色观测；方法上用估计深度把初始帧反投影为点云，与目标轨迹对齐尺度后沿轨迹渲染，得到显式几何引导与覆盖掩码，并提出 Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention（GAMA），借初始帧与多视角锚点联合估计的相对位姿在统一坐标系下检索并注入视角相关角色特征。实验显示大角度轨迹下相机跟随准确，角色几何、外观与身份保持良好。
hf.reason: 角色视频生成与相机控制，属视觉生成方向，与 LLM 无关

hf.title: Spatial Audio Generation and Editing with Executable Plans and Self-Distilling Transfusion
hf.abstract: Spatial audio authoring coordinates source decisions with soundfield synthesis. For editing, plans specify what to change and retain, while reference audio supplies further acoustic detail. We present AMBIT, a unified framework for native First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) generation and editing with three connected contributions. First, a shared Transfusion backbone couples autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering through executable ScenePlans that specify source content, activity, and 3D trajectories. For editing, the plan describes the full target scene, including retained sources; contrastive features ground the requested change, while full reference latents supply residual acoustic detail for preservation. Second, an FOA-aware continuous VAE combines shared-decoder omnidirectional recovery, asymmetric grouped KL, and spatial covariance matching to preserve content and inter-channel structure. Third, joint Transfusion on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) refines planning on student-generated prefixes and rendering at sampling states reached under student plans, with target-conditioned teachers supervising both modes of the shared student. Evaluations across speech, music, and sound show improved generation content and spatial quality, acoustic fidelity during instruction-guided editing, and unedited-source preservation over the compared baselines. Project page: https://wjm-george.github.io/AMBIT/
hf.titleZh: 基于可执行计划与自蒸馏 Transfusion 的空间音频生成与编辑
hf.summaryZh: 空间音频创作需同时决定声源与声场合成，编辑时还要明确改动与保留的内容。AMBIT 以共享 Transfusion 主干把自回归规划与 rectified-flow 渲染耦合起来，用可执行 ScenePlan 指定声源内容、活动与三维轨迹；编辑时以对比特征定位改动、以完整参考 latent 保留残余声学细节；配套 FOA 感知连续 VAE（共享解码器全向恢复、非对称分组 KL、空间协方差匹配）维持声道间结构；并用联合 on-policy 自蒸馏，在学生生成的 plan 前缀与采样状态上由目标条件教师监督。语音、音乐与音效实验显示，生成内容与空间质量、指令编辑的声学保真度及未编辑声源保持均优于基线。
hf.reason: 面向空间音频生成与编辑，属音频生成方向，仅方法层面沾边

hf.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
hf.abstract: Localized AI manipulations in long-form videos often affect brief events within otherwise authentic content, making video-level classification insufficient for forensic analysis. Existing audio-visual deepfake benchmarks largely focus on short talking-head clips, while long-form temporal forensics remains predominantly visual. We introduce AV-FABLE, a dual-timeline benchmark for sparse manipulations in open-scene long-form audio-visual videos. AV-FABLE contains 16,650 pristine--manipulated twin pairs (998 hours) created with 27 editing configurations, with separate audio and visual timelines that enable modality-specific temporal localization and expose errors hidden by joint-timeline evaluation. On AV-FABLE, zero-shot prompting of audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) yields near-chance detection and poor temporal localization. In contrast, supervised readouts of their frozen perception features recover strong forensic signals, suggesting manipulation evidence is encoded in these representations but not effectively exposed through language outputs. Motivated by this observation, we propose NFSR(Native Forensics via Separated Readouts), which reads frozen AV-LLM features with separate audio and visual temporal decoders. NFSR achieves the best audio-visual localization performance in-domain and across all three out-of-distribution settings, including transfer to held-out videos from an external long-video forensic benchmark. AV-FABLE, code, and model weights will be publicly released.
hf.titleZh: AV-FABLE：长视频中的音视频操控取证
hf.summaryZh: 长视频中的局部AI操控往往只覆盖短暂事件，视频级分类无法满足取证需求，而现有音视频深度伪造基准多局限于短视频说话人片段，长时取证也以视觉为主。AV-FABLE构建了开放场景长视频稀疏操控的双时间线基准，含16650对原始-篡改孪生样本（998小时）、27种编辑配置，音视频时间线分离以支持模态特定定位并暴露联合时间线评测掩盖的错误。评测显示，音视频大模型零样本提示的检测接近随机、时间定位差，而冻结感知特征的监督读出能恢复强取证信号，据此提出的NFSR用分离的音、视频时间解码器读取冻结特征，在域内与三种分布外设定（含迁移至外部长视频取证基准）均取得最佳定位性能。
hf.reason: 音视频大模型特征用于长视频取证基准，擦边多模态理解与评测

hf.title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
hf.abstract: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality. Compared to the original recall-based reward, FORK substantially improves precision and reduces response length while achieving similar rubric coverage, which leads to significantly higher win rate compared to the base policy (e.g., from 10.6% to 68.0% on RubricHub-Medical and from 22.1% to 74.1% on HealthBench).
hf.titleZh: 吃掉你的精确率：精确率目标缓解基于评分细则的RL中的奖励黑客
hf.summaryZh: 基于评分细则（rubric）的奖励让不可验证任务也能做强化学习，但奖励通常按细则覆盖度加权，模型实际只在最大化召回，导致回答更长、含更多冗余或事实错误内容，人类偏好反而低于基座模型。FORK奖励同时优化召回与新的精确率目标：回答的每个单元须由rubric驱动的必要性得分判定为必要、并由事实正确性评分器判定为正确。实验显示FORK在RubricHub-Medical上相对基座策略胜率从10.6%升至68.0%，在HealthBench上从22.1%升至74.1%，在保持相近覆盖度的同时提升精确率并缩短回答长度，达到覆盖度与整体质量的Pareto最优。
hf.reason: 针对rubric奖励的奖励黑客问题改进RL奖励设计，属后训练核心方向

hf.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
hf.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them. A feature change observed on one transformed prompt need not recur, and even a recurring change need not affect a downstream computation. We introduce the redistribution sensitivity score (RSS), which identifies large feature responses that recur in a consistent direction, and evaluate the resulting supports on variants excluded from selection. Across 27 pretrained SAEs spanning eight language models, the tested prompt transformations produce a reproducible redistribution profile on these excluded variants. We then separate recurring representation change from signed readout contribution and decision failure. For a fixed linear readout, an exact decomposition shows how response magnitude, readout coefficients, directional alignment, and the clean margin determine downstream consequences. In two frozen safety readouts, combining RSS support erosion with the full clean margin yields recurrent failure AUROCs of 0.935 and 0.958 using median supports of 20 and 19 features, compared with 0.965 and 0.964 using full erosion. RSS therefore provides a way to identify recurring sparse representation changes and quantify their contribution to a downstream readout without equating representation change with failure. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/Redistribution-Sensitivity-Score
hf.titleZh: 稀疏自编码器中的表征重分配
hf.summaryZh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）把语言模型激活分解为稀疏特征，但保持请求不变的提示变换会让活动在特征间重新分配。提出重分配敏感度分数（RSS），识别在一致方向上重复出现的大特征响应，并在未参与选择的变体上验证可复现性；实验覆盖8个语言模型、27个预训练SAE。对固定线性读出给出精确分解，将响应幅度、读出系数、方向对齐与干净间隔同下游后果关联；在两个冻结安全读出上，RSS支持侵蚀加完整干净间隔取得0.935和0.958的复发失败AUROC，仅用约20个特征，接近完整侵蚀的0.965和0.964。该工作把表征变化与下游失败区分开，适用于SAE特征筛选与安全性分析。
hf.reason: SAE可解释性与安全读出分析，属LLM相关但非核心后训练方向

hf.title: Principia: Test-Time Hypotheses to Principle Construction for Scientific Discovery
hf.abstract: Scientific discovery requires identifying the scientific principles underlying observed phenomena to guide further investigation. As these empirical principles are often unknown in complex discovery processes, they are constructed via a hypotheses-to-principle pipeline to obtain recurring causalities from progressively accumulated observations during test-time discovery. However, constructing this knowledge requires substantial domain expertise, time, and effort, making this translation stage a bottleneck for scientific discovery. To address this limitation, we propose Principia, an LLM-based framework that constructs and continually refines scientific principles at test time. Drawing on how human researchers develop principles, Principia forms comparative causal hypotheses from related inputs and their observed outcomes, then synthesizes recurring relationships across these hypotheses into inductive principles. By applying the constructed hypotheses and inductive principles to the task, it obtains new observations, revises the hypotheses used based on these new observations, and reconstructs principles from the updated hypotheses, allowing scientific knowledge to continuously evolve throughout test-time discovery. Across benchmarks spanning molecular optimization, protein engineering, gene perturbation, and molecular property prediction, Principia outperforms baselines relying on internal knowledge, external sources, or experience summaries, while generating principles that are plausible and consistent with the scientific literature, demonstrating its effectiveness in constructing and refining task-specific hypotheses and principles at test time for scientific discovery. Our code is available at https://github.com/DongkiKim95/Principia.
hf.titleZh: Principia:面向科学发现的测试时假设到原理构建
hf.summaryZh: 针对科学发现中「从观测到原理」这一依赖领域专家、耗时费力的转化瓶颈，提出 LLM 框架 Principia:测试时先从相关输入及其观测结果构造对比性因果假设，再跨假设归纳反复出现的因果关系形成归纳原理;随后将假设与原理应用于任务获得新观测，据此修正假设并重建原理，使知识在发现过程中持续演化。在分子优化、蛋白质工程、基因扰动与分子性质预测等基准上，其表现优于依赖内部知识、外部来源或经验总结的基线，生成的原理具备合理性且与科学文献一致。
hf.reason: 测试时假设—原理自演化，属 AI for Research，但评测限于生物分子

hf.title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
hf.abstract: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation. Existing methods preserve user intent and improve overall visual appeal, with less explicit emphasis on fine-grained design dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce Qwen-Image-PE, which learns visual design through two-stage training. Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) uses dense captions of well-designed images as design supervision. Reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) jointly compares all candidate images for the same request to refine lighting, composition, layout, and detail. On Qwen-Image-Bench with Qwen-Image-2.1, Qwen-Image-PE-397B improves over original requests by 7.81 points, while Qwen-Image-PE-9B outperforms all evaluated PE baselines. Further evaluations show gains in visual design, aesthetics, image quality, and human preference. We find that PE scales along three axes: training data, model size, and information density, with sufficient information density as a prerequisite for effective enhancement. Moreover, we demonstrate that Qwen-Image-PE generalizes to four additional T2I backbones, even surpassing native prompt enhancers on HunyuanImage-2.1 and FLUX 3 Image Klein. We release Qwen-Image-PE-9B at https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I.
hf.titleZh: Qwen-Image-PE：学习面向文本到图像提示增强的视觉设计
hf.summaryZh: 现有文本到图像提示增强方法能保留用户意图并提升整体观感，但对细粒度设计维度的显式建模不足。该工作用两阶段训练学习视觉设计：先用基于描述的反向蒸馏（CRD）把优质设计图像的密集描述作为设计监督做SFT，再用组内设计奖励（GDR）对同一请求的全部候选图像联合比较做强化学习，优化光照、构图、布局与细节。在Qwen-Image-Bench上，397B版本较原始请求提升7.81分，9B版本超过所有对比的PE基线；作者还发现PE沿训练数据、模型规模、信息密度三轴扩展，且信息密度是生效前提。方法可泛化到四个额外T2I骨干，在HunyuanImage-2.1与FLUX 3 Image Klein上甚至超过原生提示增强器，9B权重已开源。
hf.reason: 面向图像生成的提示增强，属生成侧应用，仅RL后训练略沾边

hf.title: HiP3R: Hierarchical Pose Graphs for Long-Horizon 3D Reconstruction
hf.abstract: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level Sim(3) graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared SE(3) camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.
hf.titleZh: HiP3R:用于长时序三维重建的层次化位姿图
hf.summaryZh: 长视频包含数千帧时，前馈模型无法直接推理，只能切分为重叠块分别重建，由此产生坐标框架不一致与共享相机重复估计。HiP3R 用层次化位姿图化解块级与帧级优化的取舍:先优化稳健的块级 Sim(3) 图确定全局布局与尺度，再固定该布局，逐帧估计一个共享的 SE(3) 相机，把重叠窗口的预测合并为单一轨迹。多基准实验显示相机轨迹与三维重建质量均有提升，且无需额外训练或微调，即可接入 chunk-based 与 streaming 两类后端。
hf.reason: 三维重建与位姿图优化，属视觉重建低分方向

hf.title: World-in-Context: Interactive Video World Modeling with In-Context Conditioning
hf.abstract: Interactive video world models require coordinated control over viewing perspectives, character actions, and camera motion. Existing methods typically leave view modes implicit in text captions, conflate action with camera motion, and inject controls through fragmented architectural pathways that capture interdependencies only indirectly. In this work, we present World-in-Context, an interactive world modeling framework powered by In-Context Conditioning (ICC). Rather than relying on specialized conditioning pathways, World-in-Context unifies view, action, and camera controls into explicit tokens contextualized directly within a shared self-attention space. Our formulation reveals that (i) explicit view tokens disentangle conflicting dynamics and unlock emergent view switching from single-view data, while (ii) action and camera inputs play complementary roles in governing local responsiveness and global stability. To preserve temporal continuity across execution intervals, we further introduce Interaction-Transport RoPE (IT-RoPE), parameterizing temporal attention with accumulated control transitions. On WBench, World-in-Context-5B achieves navigation performance on par with 22B EchoWM (81.5 vs. 81.6) and attains a 93.8% perspective-switching success rate, substantially outperforming existing 5B baselines (18.8%). Controlled analyses further demonstrate compounding advantages of World-in-Context under richer conditioning mixtures, favorable data efficiency, and natural applicability to causal rollouts.
hf.titleZh: World-in-Context:基于上下文条件化的交互式视频世界建模
hf.summaryZh: 交互式视频世界模型需要同时控制视角、角色动作与相机运动，但现有方法把视角模式隐含在文本描述里、把动作与相机运动混为一谈，并通过割裂的架构通路注入控制信号。该工作提出 In-Context Conditioning，把视角、动作、相机三类控制统一表示为显式 token，直接置于共享自注意力空间中，无需专门的条件注入通路;并提出 Interaction-Transport RoPE，用累积的控制切换量参数化时间注意力，以维持跨交互区间的时间连续性。在 WBench 上，5B 模型取得 81.5 的导航性能，与 22B 的 EchoWM(81.6)持平，视角切换成功率达 93.8%，远超同规模基线(18.8%)。
hf.reason: 视频世界模型生成方向，不在关注画像内

hf.title: Δτ-Bench: Pushing Agents Toward a Moving Capability
hf.abstract: In this paper, we introduce Δτ-Bench, an executable agent benchmark that models the structural evolution of large tool ecosystems. In Δτ-Bench, independently evolving services continually reshape how tasks can be accomplished: familiar tools may disappear or be replaced, while more efficient alternatives emerge amid overlapping functionality and noisy documentation. Against this moving capability frontier, we evaluate whether agents can proactively discover efficient tool-use paths and promptly revise their accumulated procedural knowledge, bringing together demands that existing benchmarks fail to examine. Δτ-Bench comprises 1,588 validated multi-turn tasks across 42 domains and six successive ecosystem states generated through capability-preserving transformations. Our evaluation shows that even the strongest evaluated model or harness achieves only 42.3% task success, while initial gains from existing skill-learning methods can not consistently translate into better adaptation as the ecosystem evolves. These findings motivate Steward, an ecosystem manager that jointly manages tools and procedural knowledge through incremental skill maintenance and dynamic provisioning during task execution. Experiments show that Steward sustains higher task success across ecosystem changes with lower skill-maintenance overhead, while improving both recovery from disrupted workflows and adoption of more efficient alternatives.
hf.titleZh: Δτ-Bench:推动智能体迈向不断移动的能力前沿
hf.summaryZh: 现有 agent benchmark 多假设工具生态静态，无法考察工具消失或被替换、文档噪声与功能重叠并存时，智能体能否主动发现更高效的工具使用路径并及时修正已积累的程序性知识。Δτ-Bench 通过保持能力的变换生成六个连续生态状态，覆盖 42 个领域、1,588 个经校验的多轮任务。评测显示最强模型或 harness 仅达 42.3% 任务成功率，且既有技能学习方法的初始增益无法随生态演化稳定转化为适应能力。为此提出的 Steward 生态管理器在任务执行中增量维护技能并动态供给工具，在生态变化下保持更高成功率与更低技能维护开销，同时改善中断工作流的恢复和对更高效替代方案的采纳。
hf.reason: 动态工具生态下的 agent benchmark，直击工具调用与技能维护

hf.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement in the Era of Large Models: Foundation, Risks, Evaluation and Open Challenges
hf.abstract: AI systems built around large models increasingly use experience and feedback to make persistent changes to models, prompts, memories, tools, and workflows. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) extends this process to inductive biases and to the mechanisms that govern future updates, which can themselves be revised and reused across improvement cycles. Yet self-modification alone does not guarantee trustworthy improvement. Reported gains may reflect flawed evaluations, previously acquired capabilities may deteriorate, and compliance with behavioral constraints may weaken. Compromised artifacts or sensitive information may also persist in successor systems. Changes to improvement mechanisms may invalidate earlier verification results and make human oversight less effective. This survey presents an operational definition and process framework for RSI and organizes the requirements for trustworthy RSI into four interconnected themes: genuine and sustained improvement; behavioral constraints, alignment, and fairness; system security and privacy; and transparency and controllability. We examine these themes from three perspectives: Improvement Validity, Constraint Preservation, and Effective Oversight. This analysis covers improvement diagnosis, proposal generation, proposal evaluation, and update implementation (S1--S4), including the recursive application of these stages to improvement mechanisms (RI). We review risks, safeguards, and evaluation evidence for individual updates, effects inherited by successor systems, and revisions to improvement mechanisms, while distinguishing direct RSI findings from evidence in related systems. Finally, we examine evaluation settings, identify requirements for independent and longitudinal assessment, and discuss applications and open research problems.
hf.titleZh: 大模型时代的可信递归自我改进：基础、风险、评估与开放挑战
hf.summaryZh: 递归自我改进（RSI）使系统不仅能更新模型、提示、记忆与工具，还能改写支配未来更新的归纳偏好和改进机制本身。该综述给出了RSI的操作性定义与流程框架，并指出自我修改并不必然带来可信改进：报告中的增益可能源于评估缺陷，已有能力可能退化，行为约束与对齐可能减弱，受损产物与敏感信息还可能残留在后继系统中。综述围绕四个相互关联的主题展开：真实且持续的改进、约束与公平性、安全与隐私、透明与可控；并从改进有效性、约束保持、有效监督三个视角，审视改进诊断、方案生成、评估与实施（S1–S4）以及这些阶段对改进机制的递归应用（RI）。文中还梳理了相关风险、防护措施与评估证据，区分了RSI的直接发现和相关系统中的证据，并提出独立评估与纵向评估的要求与开放问题。
hf.reason: 自我改进与自进化方向综述，框架完整，直接命中后训练兴趣

hf.title: Evolving to Match Capabilities: Improving Harness Self-Evolution via Skill Adaptation
hf.abstract: Harness self-evolution offers a practical route for LLM agents to improve from execution experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on whether models can successfully act on the guidance provided by their harnesses. However, we find that harness benefits are not uniform across model capabilities: skills that improve stronger models can provide little benefit or even degrade performance for weaker ones. Across seven models and three benchmarks, we identify 103 task-skill pairs where skills improve GPT-5.6-luna by 31.1 points but degrade Gemma-4-E4B by 8.8 points. In 86% of failed weak-model runs, the violated requirement is already stated in the skill. This motivates skill adaptation: reformulating existing skills to match the executor's capabilities and make their guidance easier to execute. To achieve this, we diagnose failures in tool execution, context management, instruction following, and verification, and distill these diagnoses into a fixed meta-skill that guides adaptation during harness self-evolution. Guided by the meta-skill, a capable external rewriter, Kimi-K3, adapts skills without execution evidence, improving the three weak executors by 5.1-14.1 points over the original skills. We then incorporate this adaptation into a five-round self-evolution loop, where each model revises its own skill from execution trajectories and verifier feedback. Across seven executors, from Gemma-4-E4B to Kimi-K2.5, the meta-skill consistently improves final scores by 2.0-5.1 points over the same loop without the meta-skill. Our findings provide practical design guidance for developing more effective harness self-evolution methods.
hf.titleZh: 演化以匹配能力：通过技能适配改进Harness自演化
hf.summaryZh: Harness自演化让LLM Agent无需更新参数即可从执行经验中提升，但技能收益随能力而异：103个任务—技能对使GPT-5.6-luna提升31.1分，却使Gemma-4-E4B下降8.8分，86%的弱模型失败所违反的要求已写在技能中。为此提出技能适配：把工具执行、上下文管理与验证等失败诊断蒸馏为固定meta-skill，指导改写器在无执行证据下重写技能，使三个弱执行器提升5.1—14.1分；接入五轮自演化循环后，7个执行器依据轨迹与验证反馈改写自身技能，较无meta-skill版本提升2.0—5.1分。
hf.reason: Agent harness自演化与技能适配，实验系统且直接命中方向

hf.title: miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. We show that matching model weights and numerical formats is insufficient to ensure consistent policy evaluation, highlighting the importance of cross-engine numerical execution. We introduce miniTE, a lightweight framework that combines execution diagnostics, cross-engine numerical alignment, and efficient native W4A4 (4-bit weights and activations) GEMM computation for LLM RL. It improves numerical execution consistency without modifying the RL objective, while reducing implementation overhead to realize the benefits of native low-bit computation. Long-horizon RL experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate stable training and benchmark performance close to BF16, outperforming naive Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4 in evaluation quality. On single NVIDIA B300 GPU node, the optimized learner reaches 33,540 tokens/s, yielding 1.39x and 1.47x the throughput of BF16 and TE NVFP4, respectively, for complete learner updates. We released the framework, kernels, diagnostics, and training configurations to make native low-bit RL easier.
hf.titleZh: miniTE:诊断与弥合原生 NVFP4 强化学习中的执行鸿沟
hf.summaryZh: 原生 NVFP4 低比特计算有望加速 LLM 强化学习，但在训练引擎与采样引擎分离的流程中难以稳定:仅对齐权重与数值格式并不足以保证策略评估一致，跨引擎数值执行才是关键。miniTE 结合执行诊断、跨引擎数值对齐与高效的 W4A4(4 比特权重与激活)GEMM，在改动 RL 目标的前提下提升数值执行一致性，并降低低比特实现的开销。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的长程 RL 实验训练稳定，评测质量接近 BF16，优于朴素 Transformer Engine NVFP4;单台 NVIDIA B300 节点上学习器吞吐达 33,540 tokens/s，完整学习器更新分别为 BF16 与 TE NVFP4 的 1.39 倍与 1.47 倍。
hf.reason: 原生 NVFP4 量化 RL 训练系统，同时命中效率与后训练方向

hf.title: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally unreasonable actions in preferred trajectories and ignores each action's downstream deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9% and 94.3% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7% and 70.8% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to 2.44times while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS
hf.titleZh: ProAS：面向多轮智能体强化学习的进度感知优势塑造框架
hf.summaryZh: 针对GRPO等无critic算法将轨迹级优势均匀广播到所有动作、导致偏好轨迹中不合理动作被强化、非偏好轨迹中动作的下游偏差被忽略的问题，提出即插即用的进度感知优势塑造框架ProAS，用动态演化的Agentic Reference Graph实现细粒度信用分配，并以「屏蔽不合理激励」（MUI）与「非对称惩罚重分配」（APR）两个机制落地，不引入critic开销。在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，ProAS将主流group-based基线统一推至新的SOTA，ALFWorld成功率分别达91.9%与94.3%，WebShop达66.7%与70.8%，训练收敛速度最高提升2.44倍，且对不完美或蒸馏得到的ARG保持稳健。该工作为多轮Agentic RL的信用分配提供了可直接叠加到现有后训练流程的通用组件。
hf.reason: Agentic RL信用分配改进，直击GRPO均匀优势痛点，实验扎实

hf.title: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
hf.abstract: Critic-free methods are widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, avoiding difficult and costly critic training. Common alternatives lack token-level credit assignment and typically rely on grouped rollouts to estimate prompt-specific baselines. A critic can address both limitations, but long-CoT critic training is hindered by insufficient coverage of trajectories with diverse lengths and early gradients dominated by the newly initialized value head. We introduce S3AC (Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic) for LLM reasoning, built around a practical critic-training recipe. The trained critic provides token-specific advantages and prompt-specific baselines. Using the prompt-level baseline to estimate difficulty, we propose Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling (DAPS). DAPS combines this estimate with outcome history to select prompts before generation, reducing rollout waste without offline difficulty initialization. S3AC improves group-rollout performance across dense and mixture-of-experts models from 1.5B to 397B parameters, outperforming a modern GRPO variant (GRPO-X). At 35B, it sustains single-rollout training while tested critic-free baselines deteriorate after initial gains.
hf.titleZh: S3AC：面向 LLM 推理的稳定、选择性、可扩展 Actor-Critic
hf.summaryZh: 针对无 critic 的 RLVR 方法缺乏 token 级信用分配、只能靠组采样估计 prompt 基线的问题，给出一套可落地的长 CoT critic 训练配方，缓解轨迹长度覆盖不足与 value head 初期梯度主导两个障碍，由 critic 同时提供 token 级优势与 prompt 级基线。再利用该基线估计难度并结合历史结果，在生成前做 Difficulty-Aware Prompt Sampling（DAPS），减少无效 rollout 且无需离线难度初始化。在 1.5B 至 397B 的 dense 与 MoE 模型上均优于 GRPO-X 变体；35B 规模下可维持单次 rollout 训练，而无 critic 基线在初期收益后明显退化。

hf.title: RynnVLA-Latent: Scaling Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models with 3D-Grounded Latent Actions
hf.abstract: Scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models is constrained by scarce action-labeled demonstrations and incompatible control spaces across robot embodiments. We present RynnVLA-Latent, a framework that turns heterogeneous interaction videos into scalable supervision for robot policy pretraining. At its core, RynnLAM learns continuous, 3D-grounded latent actions from visual transitions without requiring native robot controls. By combining residual future-feature prediction, camera-compensated 3D-flow supervision, and camera-motion decoupling, RynnLAM encourages representations that capture control-relevant motion rather than appearance changes alone. We apply RynnLAM to 30.1K hours of human, robot, and simulation videos, producing 745.52M latent-action descriptors. RynnVLA-Latent then learns to predict latent-action chunks from visual observations and language through flow matching, before adapting its pretrained backbone and action expert to embodiment-specific robot actions. The resulting 4B policy achieves 98.8% success on LIBERO, 84.7% on LIBERO-Plus without benchmark-specific adaptation, 51.9% average success across five VLABench tracks, and 88.6% average success on the RoboTwin 2.0 bimanual benchmark. It also achieves the highest observed success rates among the compared methods on six real-world manipulation tasks across dexterous-hand and mobile-gripper platforms. Together with representation ablations and data-scaling results, these findings demonstrate the potential of latent-action supervision for scaling robot policy learning beyond native action-labeled data.
hf.titleZh: RynnVLA-Latent：以3D grounded 潜在动作扩展机器人操作基础模型
hf.summaryZh: 针对动作标注示教数据稀缺、不同机器人本体控制空间互不兼容的问题，将异构交互视频转化为可扩展的机器人策略预训练监督。核心组件 RynnLAM 无需原生机器人控制信号，通过残差未来特征预测、相机补偿的3D光流监督与相机运动解耦，从视觉变化中学习连续且具3D grounding 的潜在动作表征；在30.1K小时人类、机器人与仿真视频上生成745.52M条潜在动作描述符后，RynnVLA-Latent 用 flow matching 从视觉观测与语言预测潜在动作块，再适配各本体的真实动作。所得4B策略在 LIBERO 上达98.8%成功率、LIBERO-Plus 84.7%、VLABench 五个赛道平均51.9%、RoboTwin 2.0 双臂基准88.6%，并在六项真实操作任务上取得对比方法中最高成功率。

hf.title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
hf.abstract: Embodied agents are expected to accomplish real-world goals by deciding for themselves how and when to interact with their surroundings. For many such goals, changing the physical state of the world is the means rather than the end: the agent changes the state of a system through interaction, observes the feedback, and explores until it either achieves the goal itself (e.g., discovering physical laws) or learns what the goal requires; it acts to know. Manipulation benchmarks stop at acting to change, with the target state given; scientific discovery benchmarks evaluate knowing but replace physical experimentation with symbolic actions or numerical queries. We introduce EmbodiedLab, a benchmark in which a robot must act to know. Quantitative science experiments make this setting controllable: the parameters of the system are resampled for every instance, so the result cannot be known in advance, yet it can be scored exactly. Across 30 experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms, the agent receives an objective and the apparatus, chooses its own procedure, and operates a physics-based simulated laboratory, reading the instruments through its cameras. Evaluation checks what the agent came to know, grounded in readings recorded during the episode, as well as the physical state the task requires; every experiment is verified to be solvable. We evaluate six frontier models in their developers' coding agents with native observation and control, with added perception and motion planning, and with manipulation skills distilled from the strongest agents. With native control, even the strongest agent succeeds less than half the time; for every agent, most failures arise in interacting with the apparatus, and manipulation skills help weaker agents more than perception and planning. The benchmark and its evaluation code are available at https://github.com/HexaFuture/EmbodiedLab.
hf.titleZh: EmbodiedLab：评测「以行动求知」的具身智能体基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有操作类基准只考察「行动以改变状态」且目标状态已给定，科学发现类基准则用符号动作或数值查询替代真实实验，缺少「通过动手实验获取知识」的评测。EmbodiedLab 让机器人在基于物理仿真的实验室中自行决定实验流程、通过相机读取仪器，完成覆盖五个学科、14 种装置平台的 30 个定量科学实验；每个实例的系统参数重新采样，结果无法预先获知却可精确评分，评测同时检查智能体获得的知识与任务要求的物理状态，且每项实验均验证可解。在开发者自带的编码智能体框架下评测六个前沿模型，即使最强模型的原生控制成功率也不足一半，多数失败源于与装置交互；蒸馏得到的操作技能对弱模型的增益大于感知与规划增强。
hf.reason: 具身智能体与机器人操作基准，属画像明确低分方向

hf.title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
hf.abstract: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.
hf.titleZh: CausalAlign：面向一致自我运动的视频生成模型因果对齐
hf.summaryZh: 扩散式视频生成模型能产出视觉上合理的视频，但相机自我运动在长时段上常发生漂移，破坏几何与轨迹的一致性。CausalAlign 先用线性探针与因果干预定位去噪过程中自我运动表征的「先升后降」规律，再把所定位层的表征经 delta-token 空间对齐到 3D 基础模型；该空间编码相邻帧之间的变化，使对齐聚焦于运动动态而非静态场景内容。基于 DL3DV 与 RealEstate10K 微调 Wan2.2 后，几何一致性相对基线提升逾 20%，并使 RoboCasa365 移动操作任务上 world action model 的成功率提升 10 个百分点。

hf.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
hf.abstract: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.
hf.titleZh: 《构建而非游玩:自我改进的 LLM 研究智能体打造出媲美顶尖玩家的炉石传说酒馆战棋 AI》
hf.summaryZh: 在炉石传说酒馆战棋(八人自动战斗、随机商店、隐藏信息、近千张卡牌)上检验 LLM 智能体能否独立走到人类顶尖水平。AutoTavern 让多个专门化研究智能体共享带类型的科研记忆，每条论断须过验证门，实盘对局闭环反馈，同步改进模拟器、对手、策略与科研流程，人只设目标并裁定模糊机制。20 天内建成全内容复现的 TavernGym 和 23 版 PPO 训练的 TavernAgent:天梯分从 6000 升至约 15000，近 20 局平均名次 1.60、80% 第一，全面超过服务器前十(2.34、59%);TavernBench 960 题解题率 91%(前沿 LLM ≤63%)，单次决策 0.03 s,1 s 实时约束下仍保 90%。说明研究智能体「造」远强于「玩」。
hf.reason: 研究智能体+环境合成+PPO 闭环，直击 Agent 与自进化方向

hf.title: Extreme Compression of Per-Layer Embeddings via Cross-Layer Latent Vector Quantization
hf.abstract: Scaling embedding capacity alongside Transformer computation is an emerging trend in language models. This trend makes high compression rates increasingly useful. Hence, we study extreme compression of Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE), which follow this trend and account for 35.2% of the parameters of Gemma 4 E4B. At such rates, conventional quantizers give each token-layer vector its own code of only a few bytes. We instead develop OPTIC (Output-Path-fitted, Token-shared Indexed Codes), which stores one quantized code tuple per token and decodes it at every layer with a layer-specific affine decoder. Codes and decoders are fitted to the PLE output path rather than to the stored vectors. At about 100times PLE compression of bfloat16 (BF16) E4B, OPTIC retains an aggregate 97.8% of the uncompressed model's performance across seven benchmarks, whereas product quantization, the strongest of six conventional baselines, retains 66.3%. At 594times and 1,002times PLE compression of BF16 E4B, OPTIC retains 90.5% and 84.1%. On the official E4B release with 4-bit linear weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16), OPTIC retains 96.9% at about 100times PLE compression. During inference at about 100times PLE compression, BF16 E4B uses 29.7% less GPU memory than with uncompressed PLE at the same key-value cache size, while running at most 0.40% slower.
hf.titleZh: 通过跨层隐向量量化实现逐层嵌入的极限压缩
hf.summaryZh: Per-Layer Embeddings(PLE)让嵌入容量随 Transformer 计算量同步扩张，在 Gemma 4 E4B 中已占参数量的35.2%，常规量化器在极限压缩率下只能给每个 token-layer 向量分配几字节独立码本。OPTIC 改为每个 token 只存一个量化码元组，并在每一层用层特定的仿射解码器还原，码与解码器直接拟合 PLE 的输出路径而非存储向量本身。在约100倍于 BF16 E4B 的 PLE 压缩率下，OPTIC 在七个基准上保留 97.8% 的聚合性能，而最强的传统基线乘积量化仅保留 66.3%;压缩率达594倍与1,002倍时仍分别保留 90.5% 与 84.1%。在官方 W4A16 E4B 发布版上约100倍压缩仍保留 96.9%，推理显存降低 29.7% 且速度最多慢 0.40%。
hf.reason: 嵌入极限压缩，属高效推理与模型架构方向，结果扎实

hf.title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
hf.abstract: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.
hf.titleZh: iPrefBench:面向个性化移动使用 Agent 的以用户为中心基准
hf.summaryZh: 真实用户请求常常欠指定，Agent 必须从用户历史活动中推断缺失信息，并向用户询问只能由用户提供的信息。iPrefBench 在可执行的 iOS 环境中搭建可交互的模拟用户，基于包含 3,051 条历史活动事件的一致人格画像，覆盖 26 个应用的 130 个欠指定任务，且每个被省略的用户相关需求在构造上要么可从历史推断、要么只能询问用户。评测同时考察个性化任务完成与用户-Agent 交互，7 个前沿 Agent 动作完成率最高达 91.6%，但完整任务成功率仅 47.7%，在只能询问的信息上尤其失败，说明个性化 Agent 的关键短板在于判断何时应当提问。

hf.title: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
hf.abstract: Long-video generators increasingly retrieve past visual observations to prevent identity drift. The intuition is compelling: more access to history should make future video more consistent. But an image can be faithful to the past and wrong for the present. Does visual memory always improve the generated story? We investigate this question through VMem-Bench, a two-track diagnostic study. Track-A measures which references are selected from 92 real films (16,548 segments), before generation and without generator confounds. Track-B compares four retrieval policies with no-memory and gold-informed last-seen controls on 30 causally generated stories (2,824 segments) using a shared generator. Retrieval increases entity recall from 0.559 to 0.628-0.693 and improves similarity to past appearances, but decreases precision from 0.977 to 0.915-0.938 and forbidden-entity avoidance from 0.968 to 0.845-0.898. It can also reinforce obsolete appearances after the story changes them. Conversely, high long-gap recall can arise without memory when the prompt itself supplies the appearance; an appearance-stripping analysis exposes this confound. These results distinguish historical fidelity from current-story correctness and show why retrieval relevance or final-video consistency alone does not establish memory utility.
hf.titleZh: 更多记忆，更好的视频？长视频生成中视觉记忆的受控研究
hf.summaryZh: 针对长视频生成中「检索更多历史画面即可抑制身份漂移」的直觉，构建 VMem-Bench 双轨诊断：Track-A 在 92 部真实电影的 16548 个片段上，于生成前、排除生成器干扰地测量参考片段的选择；Track-B 在 30 个因果生成故事的 2824 个片段上，用同一生成器比较四种检索策略与无记忆、金标最后出现两种控制。检索把实体召回从 0.559 提升到 0.628–0.693、提升与过往外观的相似度，但精度从 0.977 降到 0.915–0.938，禁止实体规避从 0.968 降到 0.845–0.898，还会在剧情改变外观后强化已过时的形象；外观剥离分析进一步显示，长间隔召回可在无记忆时由提示本身提供外观而虚高。

hf.title: Rethinking Video Storage for AI Training: Breaking Cross-Frame Dependencies for Efficient Random Access
hf.abstract: Large-scale AI training increasingly relies on massive video datasets with random temporal sampling patterns. However, existing video storage paradigms are optimized for sequential playback and employ sophisticated inter-frame reference structures to maximize compression efficiency. When applied to the random-sampling workloads of AI training, these paradigms face substantial decoding-efficiency bottlenecks. Workarounds such as independent JPEG frames and short groups of pictures (GOPs) reduce decoding work at the cost of larger storage and transfer volumes. In this paper, we identify two sources of decode amplification: sequential reconstruction of unrelated frames and reconstruction of the reference chains required by sampled targets. We address both sources by co-designing the decoding schedule and video reference structure. Dependency-aware sparse decoding reconstructs only requested frames and their required references, skipping unrelated reconstruction without transcoding the source videos. Optional offline Dependency-Decoupled Random Access (DDRA) encoding further reduces reference reconstruction by restricting each interior frame to two bounding intra-coded anchors. Together, sparse decoding and DDRA retain inter-frame prediction while bounding reconstruction to at most three frames per requested target, independent of the intra period. Experiments on a large-scale robotics corpus show that, at comparable reconstruction quality, our method achieves 1.45times the loading throughput of LeRobot v3 with 58.7% less media payload.
hf.titleZh: 重新思考 AI 训练的视频存储：打破跨帧依赖以实现高效随机访问
hf.summaryZh: AI 训练对视频做随机时间采样时，传统为顺序播放设计的帧间参考结构会造成解码放大：既要顺序重建无关帧，又要重建被采样目标的参考链。工作将解码调度与视频参考结构协同设计：依赖感知稀疏解码只重建被请求帧及其必要参考，跳过无关重建且无需转码；可选的 DDRA 离线编码把每个内部帧约束到两个边界帧内编码锚点。二者结合把每个目标的解码量上界压到最多三帧，且与帧内周期无关；在机器人语料上，重建质量相当时加载吞吐为 LeRobot v3 的 1.45 倍，媒体负载减少 58.7%。
hf.reason: 视频存储与解码优化，属系统效率擦边，非 LLM 核心方向
